rule: Describe Jamie's evidenced actions directly while preserving collaborators' authorship, institutional authority, and collective causality. A project's outcome never proves one person's sole authorship or causation.

projects.publicRule: Credit Jamie's long-running technical and operational stewardship as a contribution within a family business, not as sole cause of company performance.
boundaries: Do not publish private business metrics or operating data.
Do not convert contribution language into sole causality.

projects.publicRule: Credit Jamie with independently developing the follow-on project and its public system where supported; credit the hackathon, public participation, and Council engagement to their participants and institutions.
boundaries: Council-account engagement is not endorsement or policy impact.
Recovered social records are not a lifetime archive or complete authorship record.

projects.publicRule: Name Jamie's documented websites, operating systems, facilitation, and source-backed policy work while presenting legislation and advocacy outcomes as coalition and public-institution work.
boundaries: Do not claim Jamie alone passed, caused, or authored legislation.
Preserve named collaborators' and organizations' roles when a source establishes them.

projects.publicRule: Credit Jamie's documented campaign-memory, source-mapping, implementation, and facilitation work while preserving policy authorship, legal authority, coalition strategy, and legislative action as distinct collective and institutional roles.
boundaries: Do not attribute coalition policy or legislation solely to Jamie.
Do not expose protected strategy, legal-review context, stakeholder records, or private correspondence.

projects.publicRule: State Jamie's supported co-founding, organizing, campaign-site, participation-system, and civic-translation work directly while crediting collaborators, artists, venues, agencies, and elected officials for their own actions and collective outcomes.
boundaries: Do not turn coalition victories into Jamie's sole causality or authorship.
Shared-account posts and events do not establish one teammate's authorship without additional evidence.

projects.publicRule: Credit Jamie's documented behind-the-scenes digital infrastructure and naming support while preserving public organizer, grant, fiscal-sponsor, and campaign decisions with the people and organizations identified by the campaign.
boundaries: Do not describe Jamie as a named public organizer without collaborator corroboration.
Do not expose applicants, grantees, donors, list members, payment records, credentials, or private campaign materials.

projects.publicRule: Describe WOW List as Jamie and Richard Love's project and distinguish Jamie's supported product, engineering, editorial, event, and social-presence responsibilities from community contributions.
boundaries: Do not attribute every listing, event, or social post to Jamie without authorship evidence.
Platform activity does not by itself establish reach or impact.

projects.publicRule: Credit Jamie's documented hosting, program design, tools, and participation infrastructure while preserving the gathering as work made with hosts, residents, artists, and guests.
boundaries: Do not turn participation into a sole-author artwork.
Keep participant identities and private gathering records protected unless permission is documented.

projects.publicRule: State Jamie's evidenced construction coordination, survey design, neighborhood practice, public-benefit documentation, and stewardship transition; distinguish those actions from board, Council, organizational, and neighborhood decisions.
boundaries: Appropriation does not establish receipt or disbursement.
Do not encode the private family circumstances surrounding the transition.

projects.publicRule: Credit Jamie's method design and implementation where supported while naming pilots, source materials, reviews, and resulting decisions as collaborative contexts.
boundaries: AI archival review is not collaborator testimony.
Do not expose private team records or imply model output is verified fact.

projects.publicRule: Credit Jamie's documented augmented-reality, web, and technical contributions while preserving Claudette Bruce, participating artists, hosts, audiences, and project partners as authors of their own work.
boundaries: Do not convert technical implementation into sole artistic authorship or project ownership.
Do not publish participant identities, images, or private project records without documented permission.

projects.publicRule: Describe Jamie's evidenced workflow, documentation, implementation, and handoff contributions directly while preserving collaborators' decisions, expertise, authorship, and responsibility for their own work.
boundaries: Do not generalize one supported workflow into ownership of an entire organization or team.
Do not expose client, collaborator, operational, or handoff records that are not approved for publication.

projects.publicRule: Credit Jamie's documented prototypes, installations, research, and classroom contributions while distinguishing individual experiments from group projects, faculty evaluation, and later interpretations of the work.
boundaries: Do not attribute group-project concepts or execution solely to Jamie when records identify collaborators.
Historical faculty evaluations establish observed student work, not present-day endorsement or professional certification.

projects.publicRule: Credit Jamie's documented design, printing, mapping, outreach, and operational coordination while preserving Pastor Lee's corridor concept and the authority and labor of residents, neighborhood associations, churches, and city staff.
boundaries: Do not claim Jamie originated Cleveland Avenue Unify to Beautify or acted alone for participating neighborhoods.
First-person accounts of program operations remain bounded until public records or collaborators provide corroboration.

projects.publicRule: State Jamie's evidenced program design, facilitation, documentation, and technical work while crediting residents, artists, public agencies, host institutions, and collaborators for their participation and decisions.
boundaries: Do not turn public attendance or participation into proof of Jamie's sole authorship or measurable impact.
Do not publish participant records, private correspondence, or undocumented claims about institutional outcomes.

projects.publicRule: Credit Jamie's documented Open House artistic, publishing, hosting, and technical practice while preserving the contributions of co-organizers, participating artists, venues, audiences, and institutional partners.
boundaries: Do not describe a participatory or hosted project as Jamie's work alone when others shaped its form.
Do not publish private participant material or infer later outcomes beyond what recovered sources establish.

projects.publicRule: Credit Jamie's documented waterway journeys, public programs, artworks, and participatory methods while preserving collaborators, hosts, residents, institutions, and encountered communities as distinct contributors.
boundaries: Do not transform reported encounters or participation into broad community endorsement or verified social impact.
Distinguish contemporaneous published reporting from Jamie's later interpretation and private archival memory.

projects.publicRule: Describe Jamie's evidenced participatory waterway practice and media work directly while crediting collaborators, participants, hosts, institutions, and local communities for their own roles and knowledge.
boundaries: Do not collapse related projects into one chronology or claim complete recovery of the historical record.
Do not identify participants or publish private media without source verification, rights review, and consent where needed.
